verdict.rationale: Self-hosting under an open-source license is a fair question for a design platform, so the axis applies. Framer's evidence describes only its own hosted builder, with publishing, staging on framer.app domains and static files hosted on Framer plans. Nothing shows a self-hostable or open-source distribution, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host the full design platform on my own infrastructure under an open-source license
